world.title: Huang Apologizes to Nvidia Staff After Returning as CEO
world.summary: Jensen Huang apologized to employees during an all-hands meeting a day after his reinstatement as Nvidia’s chief executive officer. Speaking at the company’s Santa Clara, California-headquarters, Huang acknowledged violating the company's code of conduct. Bloomberg Intelligence's Matthew Bloxham breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)

world.title: Anthropic Shares Fall Below IPO Price of $83
world.summary: Anthropic PBC shares sank 6% below their $83 initial public offering price, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab’s record-setting debut last week. Bloomberg's Carmen Reinicke reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

world.title: Anthropic's Claude Ship lets AI agents review, fix, and approve pull requests on their own
world.summary: Anthropic has introduced Claude Ship, a new tool currently in beta that automatically reviews, corrects, and approves suggestions for code changes in accordance with team guidelines.

world.title: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
world.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up.
